tools.description: Add a unit operation. An id that already exists is replaced, so the call is retryable.

parameters.description: Parameter values, keyed by the entry's own names.

tools.name: add_instance

tools.description: Remove a unit operation, and every connection and recycle that named it.
tools.name: remove_instance

tools.description: Join a feed or an outlet to an inlet or a product. An outlet is `instance.port`, and a `many` outlet takes a position: `split1.products[0]`.
tools.name: connect

tools.description: Remove the first connection or recycle that joins these two endpoints.

from.description: The producing endpoint, as it was written.

to.description: The consuming endpoint, as it was written.

tools.name: disconnect

tools.description: Set one parameter of one instance. The value's JSON kind follows the declaration: a number for a quantity, a list for a vector, a switch for a boolean, a name for an enum.

value.description: The value, in the declaration's kind.

tools.name: set_parameter

tools.description: Remove a parameter's value, leaving it to the declaration's own default.
tools.name: unset_parameter

tools.description: Add a boundary feed. `h` is not settable: it is a state function of `T`, `P` and `z` and the kernel derives it.
tools.name: add_input

tools.description: Remove a boundary feed, and every connection that drew from it.
tools.name: remove_input

tools.description: Declare a boundary product. An output is calculated, so a product is a name only.
tools.name: add_product

tools.description: Remove a boundary product, and every connection that wrote to it.
tools.name: remove_product

tools.description: Declare a tear: the connection that closes a loop, under a name of its own.

from.description: The outlet the loop leaves from.

to.description: The inlet the loop returns to.

tools.name: add_recycle

tools.description: Remove a tear, leaving its endpoints as an ordinary pair of connections.
tools.name: remove_recycle

tools.description: Set one convergence parameter of one tear. A tear that does not converge is reported, not raised.

field.description: Which of the tear's seven settings.

value.description: A number for the six settings that are numbers. For                              `acceleration_method`, one of `recycle::ACCELERATION_NAMES` - and                              note that `broyden` is **refused by this port**, for the reason the                              class's own capture measures, so the checker reports it rather than                              the run.

tools.name: set_recycle

tools.description: Return one of a tear's settings to the class's own default. An unstated setting and a stated one that happens to equal the default are different documents, which is why this exists rather than a `set` back to the default.

field.description: Which of the tear's seven settings.

tools.name: unset_recycle_field

tools.description: Place a node on the canvas, by node id: `instance:sep1`, `input:feed_1`, `product:out`.
tools.name: set_position

unit_ops.name: Packed column

parameters.description: the column's internal diameter; a value at or below zero auto-sizes it from the hydraulics, and the class defaults it to -1.0
parameters.name: column_diameter

parameters.description: the fraction of flood the packing is sized to, which the hydraulics reads and the solve does not; the class defaults it to 0.70
parameters.name: design_flood_fraction

parameters.description: the packed bed height, which the constructor divides by a 0.5 m HETP guess to fix the base column's stage count and which the hydraulics later divides by the calculated HETP to report theoretical stages; the class defaults it to 5.0
parameters.name: packed_height

parameters.description: the selected packing's relative hydraulic capacity factor, which the hydraulics reads; the class defaults it to 1.0
parameters.name: packing_hydraulic_capacity_factor

parameters.description: the packing's name, which `PackingSpecificationLibrary` resolves and the hydraulics reads; the class defaults it to Pall-Ring-50
parameters.name: packing_type

parameters.description: whether the packing is structured or random, which selects the hydraulic correlation
parameters.name: structured_packing

unit_ops.refusal: its palette entry declares the packing and not the column: `feed_stage`, `number_of_stages`, the two pressures and the two ends are what `PackedColumn.run` reads through `super.run`, and the entry's own notes say it takes `unit_ops.distillation_column`'s whole declaration - which the file does not carry. A form built from this entry could not configure the machine, so the executor refuses it until the declaration matches the notes

unit_ops.name: Rate-based packed column

parameters.description: the column's internal diameter, which the hydraulics and the interfacial area are computed on; the class defaults it to 1.0
parameters.name: column_diameter

parameters.description: fixed_point_profile, the counter-current liquid profile iteration, or equation_oriented, a column-wide damped Newton with homotopy continuation; the class defaults to the first
parameters.name: column_solver

parameters.description: the outlet convergence tolerance the profile iterates to, which the class defaults to 1.0e-8

parameters.description: overall_two_resistance, a scalar gas and liquid film pair, or maxwell_stefan_matrix, which corrects it with NeqSim's binary diffusivities and the phase composition; the class defaults to the matrix

parameters.description: none, which re-equilibrates the segment outlets after material transfer alone, or chilton_colburn_analogy, which takes the heat coefficients from the packed-bed film coefficients; the class defaults to the analogy

parameters.description: onda_1968 or billet_schultes_1999, which is the wetted-area and film-coefficient correlation; the class defaults to onda_1968
parameters.name: mass_transfer_correlation

parameters.description: the counter-current profile iteration cap, which the class defaults to 30
parameters.name: max_iterations

parameters.description: the axial slices the packed height is divided into, which is the model's resolution and the size of its profile; the class defaults it to 10
parameters.name: number_of_segments

parameters.description: the packed section's height, which is divided into `number_of_segments` slices; the class defaults it to 5.0
parameters.name: packed_height

parameters.description: the packing's name, which `PackingSpecificationLibrary` resolves into the wetted area and film coefficients
parameters.name: packing_type

parameters.description: sequential_explicit, which applies mass transfer then heat transfer then re-flashes, or simultaneous_residual, which solves the flux residuals and the interfacial heat balance together; the class defaults to the first
